At handover, a toast to the front-desk agent
The new month is here
Smooth Starts for Traveling Pets

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping the focus on calm, steady service as more travelers check in with pets beside them. Handlers continue to use humane methods that help animals settle, while the cabin team stays attentive once boarding begins. At the desk, staff are keeping the ledger current so any service change is easy to trace and the next shift can pick up without delay. Small details matter, and that steady routine helps everyone feel prepared.

For travelers, the message is simple: bring documents close at hand, allow a little extra space in the plan, and let the team guide each step with care. Whether the companion is small and quiet or lively and curious, the process is built to stay reassuring from first greeting to arrival, and that makes the journey easier for all involved.
